ValidationRule.description: Locked after Disclosures Out for LOs/Loan Partners. Processor profiles, Processors and Closers role and Admins edit any stage. Joey (LP on a Processor profile) locked by username.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', OR( $Profile.Name = 'Loan Officer Profile (Read Only)', AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Transaction__r.Disclosures_Out_Date__c)), OR( $User.Username = 'joey@reachhomeloans.com', AND( $Profile.Name <> 'Processor Profile', $Profile.Name <> 'Processor Profile (SF)', $UserRole.Name <> 'Processors and Closers' ) ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Submission Form is read-only once Disclosures have gone out. Contact a Processor or an Admin if it has to change.
